Established in 1974, Cortiva Institute's mission is to provide high-quality, comprehensive training programs that prepare graduates for successful careers in massage therapy, skin care, and related health and wellness fields.

Our 29 campuses have diverse origins—many were at the forefront of the development of modern massage therapy education. Our collective history of experience and innovation is a large part of what makes Cortiva Institute an industry leader today. 

Imagine your future in massage therapy or skincare with Cortiva Institute. Learn more at www.Cortiva.edu.
